challenges.name: validate-scanner-quantities
challenges.title: Write parse_qty(): validate scanner quantities
challenges.description: Warehouse operators type a quantity (1 to 9999) at the scanner prompt, and the old code trusted atoi(): "12kg" booked 12 units and an empty line booked 0. Write parse_qty(line, out) with strtol, errno and endptr: reject empty lines, text that is not a number, trailing characters and out-of-range values (including overflow), in the order the header describes, and store the value only on success. The test runner reads the lines with fgets and prints "ok <n>" or "error: <reason>" for each.
